description: Sensor effort tiers for the OTel demo, union of readout calibration sensor keys and placement groundSet ids (primary arm).

v3.note: v3 epoch used by the v3 readout cells (selected = frontend, frontendproxy, recommendationservice)

current.note: runtime worktree, catalog HEAD; selected has 11 services. Differs from v3 for selected/async.

postureCostEvidence.unit: CPU ms per offered request, paired steps, no-fault-cost, 3 blocks (mean)
postureCostEvidence.note: Per posture step, not per sensor. Step shares fall in the >10% (none->selected) and 1-10% (other steps) bins if applied to the step service group; no sensor-level cost exists. async step: four added services = 52-91% of the step per block (RESULT.md:38, per-service resources.json, not re-derived).

R-SPAN-UP.text: Span from an application service that upstream instruments as shipped. Harness guards only disable existing registrations (materialize.py:369 apply_source_placement_guards).

R-METRIC-OTLP.text: OTLP metric point from an application service that upstream instruments as shipped (same evidence as R-SPAN-UP).

R-SPANMETRICS.text: Collector spanmetrics connector output (metric names calls, duration~*). Upstream collector pipeline already exports to spanmetrics.

R-LOG-STDOUT.text: Log id from an upstream service stdout line (log ids are 12-hex hashes of stdout lines). Stdout is not controlled by OTEL_*_EXPORTER, and services run in every posture.

R-WITNESS.text: frontendproxy log line that may come from the harness-added Envoy stdout access log (obsplacement_kind witness). Template config change, no service code. Upper bound: the hash cannot separate harness witness lines from upstream Envoy stdout lines, so the whole family is tier 1 and ootb is unknown (null).
